triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing transferable subscription Rights to its Common Shareholders of record as of May 25, 2021 (the “Record Date” and such shareholders, “Record Date Shareholders”).

subject_names.value: Clough Global Dividend and Income Fund
subject_names.span: Clough Global Dividend and Income Fund Rights for 3,509,314 Shares

subject_tickers.span: The Fund’s common shares are traded on the NYSE American LLC under the symbol “GLV”.

security_class.span: Subscription Rights to Purchase Common Shares The Fund is issuing subscription rights to its common shareholders to purchase the Fund’s common shares.

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: For every three Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

price_reference.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

price_pct.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

price_floor_pct_nav.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares on May 25, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on June 22, 2021, unless the Offer is extended as described in this Prospectus (the “Expiration Date”).

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE American under the symbol “GLV RT” during the course of the Offer.

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights may also, in certain circumstances, purchase additional common shares pursuant to an Over-Subscription Privilege.

max_new_shares.span: These Rights will allow Record Date Shareholders to subscribe for new common shares of the Fund in an aggregate amount of approximately 3,509,314 common shares (the “Offer”).

notes: Single document (seq=1), 424B2 prospectus supplement (to prospectus dated May 21, 2021) for a transferable 1-for-3 rights offering (rights trade on NYSE American as 'GLV RT'). Subscription price = 85% of NAV or 95% of market price, whichever is higher, on the Expiration Date; market price = average of last reported sales prices for the five trading days preceding the Expiration Date (excluding the Expiration Date). Coded price_reference=greater_of_nav_and_market with price_pct=95 (the market leg) and price_floor_pct_nav=85 (the NAV leg acts as a floor); the filing states two percents, so price_pct is a coding choice. Rights per holder are rounded UP to the nearest number divisible by three. max_new_shares 3,509,314 is stated as 'approximately'; no secondary over-allotment is stated. Filing notes the shares currently trade at a premium to NAV. Expiration June 22, 2021 unless extended (only one date stated). Fund type evidence: 'Common shares of the Fund, as a closed-end fund, can trade at a discount to net asset value.'
